changes.summary: New-applicant thresholds double: 8,000 watch hours per 365 days or 20M Shorts views per 90 days. Shorts ad/subscription revenue sharing gets a 10M qualified-Shorts-views-per-90-days floor. Premium Lite revenue joins the pool (55% long-form / 45% Shorts split of the creator share). Current Partners are grandfathered under existing terms until the effective date.
changes.title: YouTube Partner Program overhaul announced (effective Feb 1, 2027)

changes.summary: YouTube spelled out the three buckets that lose monetization: (1) generic or repetitive template content, (2) unsatisfying or off-putting content (e.g. staged animal-rescue clips), (3) AI personas advising on sensitive topics like health or finance. AI-assisted video is still monetizable when the creator's own idea drives it; templates run at scale are not.
changes.title: Inauthentic-content monetization rules clarified (July 16, 2026)

changes.summary: Channels reposting viral clips from TikTok, Instagram, or other creators may see reduced Shorts distribution. Reaction videos and compilations are not automatically penalized — what matters is original contribution: commentary, storytelling, or substantial creative changes beyond captions, crops, or music swaps.
changes.title: October 2026 Shorts ranking update targets reposted clips

changes.summary: Public view counts now tick the moment playback starts across long-form, Shorts, and live — counts went up. Earnings and eligibility did not move with them: Partner revenue still runs on engaged views and engaged watch hours, and eligibility on qualified views/watch hours.
changes.title: View counts start at playback start (Aug 24, 2026); Partner earnings math unchanged

changes.summary: From September 3, YouTube auto-adds paid-promotion labels to undisclosed sponsorships, and creators get age and country limits for branded content. Disclose sponsorships up front — the platform now labels them for you if you don't.
changes.title: Paid product placements fold into the Branded Content Policy (Sept 2026)

changes.summary: Announced at Made on YouTube (Sept 2026). Dynamic brand segments can be added to up to 20 long-form videos at once. For product-review niches this is a second revenue line beyond ads — check eligibility in your country before planning around it.
changes.title: YouTube Shopping affiliate program to reach 35 countries by end of 2026

sources.name: AIR Media-Tech — Creator earnings compared (YouTube vs TikTok vs Instagram, 2026)

changes.summary: Only videos over a minute qualify, and roughly half of raw views end up qualifying per third-party comparison of 2026 rates. TikTok Shop commissions (averaging ~13.1% in the same report) are the bigger TikTok revenue line for many creators. Ranges, never promises.
changes.title: TikTok Creator Rewards: $0.40–$1.00 per 1,000 qualified views (creator-reported range)

changes.summary: No per-view payout program on Reels in 2026. Reported: a limited $5,000 bonus for creators joining Instagram from another platform. Brand deals remain the main way Reels views turn into money — the deal-builder math on this site is built for exactly that.
changes.title: Instagram still pays $0 per view; monetization is Gifts, Subscriptions, brand deals, affiliates

sources.name: FINN Partners Boom Scroll — October 2026 social media updates

changes.summary: In a new video series, Instagram head Adam Mosseri said ranking predicts whether someone will watch a post or share it with a friend, with recency carrying heavy weight. Guidance: optimize engagement rate over total views or likes, use trial Reels to experiment, and don't let feeds fill with whoever posts most.
changes.title: Instagram ranking signals restated (Oct 2026): originality, recency, DM shares

changes.summary: Third-party analysis reports Reels ranking weighing completion rates, replays, and shares over likes, with 45–90 seconds cited as the current sweet spot. Directional, not platform-confirmed — watch completions and shares in your own Insights before reworking a format around it.
changes.title: October 2026 adjustments prioritize engagement-driven short-form
